title: Claude Haiku 5.5
summary: Anthropic releases Claude Haiku 5.5, their latest lightweight and efficient AI model optimized for speed, cost-effectiveness, and on-device deployment while maintaining strong performance capabilities.
problem_solved: Provides developers with an ultra-fast, affordable AI model option for applications requiring low latency and resource efficiency
why_valuable: Delivers near-frontier AI capabilities at a fraction of the cost and computational requirements, making advanced AI accessible for production applications and edge devices
